paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (canonical), as plotted on y-axis
notes: CAST helioscope solar axion search (2013-2015 vacuum phase). Main result g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 (95% C.L.) for m_a <~ 0.02 eV. This is a flat bound over the coherent mass range; encoded as a horizontal line from ~1e-4 eV to 0.02 eV. Not a dark matter haloscope so no local density assumption. Above 0.02 eV sensitivity degrades (loss of coherence) - not included. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 37)) | Vision: Red solid line 'This work' traced.
